input: Register for a community first responder program

gold.taskTitle: Register for a Community First Responder Program
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to find and complete registration for a community first responder program in their area.

questions.title: Which city or region are you located in?
questions.description: Understanding the user's location to identify locally available programs.

questions.title: Have you already identified a specific program to join?
questions.description: Determining whether the user has a target program in mind or needs help finding one.

questions.title: What type of first responder role interests you most?
questions.description: Clarifying whether the user is interested in medical, fire, disaster relief, or another type of community first responder role.

questions.title: Is this through a specific organization, such as the Red Cross?
questions.description: Identifying if the user has a particular organization or agency in mind, such as CERT, Red Cross, or a local fire department.

questions.title: Do you have any prior first aid or emergency training?
questions.description: Understanding the user's existing qualifications that may affect eligibility or program level.

questions.title: Is there a deadline by which you need to register?
questions.description: Establishing any time constraints that affect how urgently the plan needs to be executed.

questions.title: Are there any schedule constraints for training or volunteering?
questions.description: Understanding the user's availability to ensure the program's time commitments are compatible.
